scripts.lint: eslint apps packages adapters tests tooling --max-warnings 0
scripts.openapi:check: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run openapi:generate --workspace apps/api && node tooling/openapi/contract-policy.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- apps/api/openapi/openapi.json
scripts.openapi:generate: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run openapi:generate --workspace apps/api
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run test:unit:run
scripts.test:telemetry:export: npm run build --workspace packages/telemetry && OTEL_EXPORT_INTEGRATION=1 node --test packages/telemetry/dist/test/telemetry.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: VITE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3101 npm run build && playwright test --tsconfig tests/e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:e2e:journey: VITE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3101 npm run build && npm run test:e2e:journey:run
scripts.test:e2e:journey:run: npm run e2e:journey:policy && E2E_FIXTURES_ENABLED=1 E2E_APP=journeys playwright test --tsconfig tests/e2e/tsconfig.json --project=journeys
scripts.test:e2e:journey:restart: npm run e2e:journey:policy && E2E_FIXTURES_ENABLED=1 E2E_APP=journey-restart playwright test --tsconfig tests/e2e/tsconfig.json --project=journey-restart
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: VITE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3101 npm run build && playwright test --tsconfig tests/e2e/tsconfig.json --grep @smoke
